title: Engineering AI Agents: schedule and papers
text:
Stanford CS 329Z · Fall 2026
Engineering AI Agents: schedule and papers
Topics, dates, videos and slides follow the official course schedule. On top of that, every lecture gets a
block of the papers cited in its slides: extracted from the PDFs and matched against arXiv by author, year and title.
151 papers in total. A paper cited by two lectures appears in both blocks, so the blocks do not add up to 151.


  Week 1Wed, Sep 23Lecture 01
  Foundations & LandscapeIntroduction — What Are Agentic Systems?Course logistics, a brief history of agents, and the anatomy of an agent: LLM core, reasoning, memory, tools, and environment. Compound AI systems and workflows vs. agents, plus the key challenges of reliability, training, safety, and evaluation.
